trips.title: Swiss Alps & Mediterranean Odyssey
trips.description: Collaborative summer exploration across Switzerland and the French Riviera with glacier hikes, scenic trains, and coastal dining.

trips.title: Kyoto & Tokyo Blossom Expedition
trips.description: Exploring ancient shrines, high-speed Shinkansen transit, ramen alleys, and digital art museums.

destinations.name: Zurich Old Town & Lake
destinations.notes: Lakeside promenade, Altstadt medieval architecture, Lindenhof viewpoint.

destinations.name: Interlaken & Jungfrau Region
destinations.notes: Alpine basecamp between Lake Thun and Brienz. High peak cogwheel railway.

destinations.name: Nice & French Riviera Coast
destinations.notes: Promenade des Anglais, Mediterranean beach relaxation, day trip to Monaco.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Check-in at Hotel Schweizerhof
itinerary.notes: Pick up Swiss Travel Passes at the station terminal counter.

itinerary.title: Lake Zurich Sunset Boat Cruise & Dinner
itinerary.notes: Book outdoor upper-deck reservation in advance.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch - Top of Europe Glacier Ascent
itinerary.notes: High-altitude warm gear required. Check webcam weather early morning.

itinerary.title: Promenade des Anglais & Old Town Food Tour
itinerary.notes: Try authentic Socca and Salade Niçoise in Cours Saleya.

expenses.title: Swiss International Airfares (Group Booking)
expenses.receiptNote: Swiss Air group booking ref #LX-94029. Split equally among 3 travelers ($420 each).

expenses.title: Interlaken Chalet Rental 4 Nights
expenses.receiptNote: Chalet Edelweiss confirmation #AIRBNB-CH-481. Split 3 ways ($280 each).

expenses.title: Swiss All-in-One Rail Travel Passes
expenses.receiptNote: 8-day consecutive Swiss Travel Passes. Settled and confirmed.

expenses.title: Welcome Fondue & Wine Dinner in Zurich
